blocks.title: Files and images of your node
blocks.description: Elements upload pictures, videos and documents here and get a stable address for each file. Programs talk to it with the node key.

items: Thumbnails, blurred placeholders and video trimming on the server
A full icon set for a site from one image

blocks.text: A file goes in once and gets a permanent address. For a picture the element keeps its size and a tiny blurred copy, so a page can show a placeholder while the picture loads.
The server measures the length of a video and trims it to the part you keep, copying the streams when it can and re-encoding only when the cut falls between keyframes.
From one image the element makes the favicon, the app icons and the picture shown when a page is shared.
Elements still call /media on the database element, and the database element passes the request here. Stored files keep their old addresses.
